programs.title: The Hunt For the Chameleon Killer
programs.desc: The global hunt for 'The Chameleon Killer,' Elaine Parent, wanted for the 1990 murder of 34-year-old Beverly McGowan; when a body is discovered in a Florida canal, law enforcement pieces together a timeline of the victim's final days.

programs.title: The Hunt For the Chameleon Killer
programs.desc: A case of mistaken identity leads to the wrong woman being summoned to court; law enforcement begins to piece together the back story of the Chameleon Killer and uncover a string of stolen identities.

programs.title: The Hunt For the Chameleon Killer
programs.desc: When the police follow up on a tip-off, the Chameleon Killer manages to slip through their grasp; it isn't long before another tip-off leads the police right to her doorstep.
